preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 10^6.
The input string consists of digits only.

preconditions.expression: input_string does not contain leading zeros in any of its parts
preconditions.description: The input string does not contain leading zeros in any of its parts.

postconditions.description: The output string is not empty.
The output string contains exactly one '+' character.
The output string contains exactly one '=' character.
The '+' character appears before the '=' character in the output string.

postconditions.expression: all(s.isdigit() and not s.startswith('0') for s in output_string.split(output_string[output_string.index('+')])[:-1])
postconditions.description: The left and middle parts of the output string do not contain leading zeros.
The right part of the output string does not contain leading zeros.
The sum of the left and middle parts is equal to the right part.
